parts:
Hi all. I want to run the models in Fig. 8 (Gamma Poisson) and Fig. 9 (Dirichlet Exponential) of the ADVI paper (https://arxiv.org/pdf/1506.03431.pdf, page 18) on the Frey faces dataset. Before I copy and paste the code from the PDF and try to get the data in the right format, etc I was wondering if someone (hi Alp!) already has the code/processed data handy.

Thanks,
Seth
